d:
Sheikh Hasina's possible return to Bangladesh on December 16 has triggered a fresh political controversy.
The Awami League has announced her planned return through a social media post.
Bangladesh Minister Humayun Kabir said Hasina can only be brought back in handcuffs through legal proceedings.
In her Tokyo address, Hasina accused the Bangladesh government of political persecution and demanded the release of prisoners.
Meanwhile, clashes in her hometown Gopalganj left around 30 people injured, adding to political tensions.
